trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops automatically once the full list is done. [10]
There is no separate task behind it — it is the reward for completing every other trophy. [1]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. [10]
Story trophies are automatic and cannot be missed, so this pops on its own as you play. [1]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

Chapter trophies pop as the story advances; nothing extra is needed. [1]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission and finish it. [10]
Like the other chapter trophies, this one is automatic story progress. [1]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Complete Chapter 3, including its closing mission. [10]
It pops with story progress and cannot be missed. [1]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Finish Chapter 4 to its end. [10]
Automatic with the story; keep playing the main missions. [1]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Play the final mission of the story and complete it. [10]
There is no mission replay, so finish the finale when you are ready for the story to end. [1]

trophies.name: Trust
guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. [10]
Mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission ends. [1]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. [10]
It pops when the heist mission is done; no side task is attached. [1]

trophies.name: Family Matters
guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. [10]
Automatic story trophy, awarded at the end of the mission. [1]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. [10]
Automatic story trophy, awarded at the end of the mission. [1]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. [10]
Automatic story trophy, awarded at the end of the mission. [1]

trophies.name: Snow Storm

Automatic story trophy, awarded at the end of the mission. [1]

trophies.name: A Long Road
guide: Work the 100% checklist: 35 rows in three groups — Story & Tasks (12), Exploration & Activities (20) and Discovery (3). [4]

Hit the agreed thresholds: card sets 15 of 18, WAiNK 100 locations, stunts 300 of 397, challenges 70 of 80, base-model vehicles 200 of 277, animals studied 100 of 255, flamingos 100 of 125, meditations 15 of 18. [1]
Some rows must be finished in full: every robbery, all 33 underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. [4]
The 45% / 45% / 10% group weights come from GTABase alone — single-source, not agreed by other guides. [4]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses and air time all count toward the total. [10]
The 100% checklist needs more, 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you want A Long Road. [1]
Chain stunts during free-roam driving sessions instead of hunting them one at a time. [1]

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Sample each of the nine activity types once — one try each is enough, no mastery needed. [10]
Activities unlock as you explore the map, so try each new one the first time you find it. [1]
Work through the nine types one by one in free roam until the trophy pops. [6]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. [10]
There are two ranges — Griffin in Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn — with 12 challenges between them. [1]
PSNProfiles counts the same 42 golds, matching the official target. [3]
Gold each challenge and retry freely; failed attempts cost nothing but time. [6]

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

counter.label: Top Fun Drone Race locations won

guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. [10]
The 100% checklist also needs 42 drone time trials across those 14 spots, so the races feed two goals at once. [1]
Learn each course once, then race it for the win — retries are free. [1]

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so variety matters more than repeats. [10]
Races across different types and locations count separately toward the 20. [6]
A lost race costs nothing; retry it or move to the next one. [6]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. [10]
Fishing challenges are available in free roam, so attempt this whenever you are near the water. [6]
If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win. [1]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Finish one arcade game to the end at any arcade machine. [10]
Arcades are open in free roam, so this is an easy early trophy. [6]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Play Andy's mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. [10]
Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no deadline on this one. [1]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Play Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. [10]
Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no deadline on this one. [1]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Play Billy's mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. [10]
Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no deadline on this one. [1]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. [10]
Only 4 strands are confirmed by name so far (Kirk, Yago, Pilot Pete and one more) — the rest have no confirmed trigger yet. [1]
WATCH: the timed Yago race in Chapter 3, marked by an hourglass icon, is reported as a risk to Yago's strand, so race Yago when the icon appears. [12]
PowerPyx states all stranger strands remain available after the story, which is why this is a watch, not a confirmed missable. [1]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Play Randy's mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. [10]
Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no deadline on this one. [1]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Play Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. [10]
Side strands stay open after the story, so there is no deadline on this one. [1]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 locations in total. [1]
Start with the first spot: the balcony of Jason's home, on the morning after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia invites you from the kitchen — it exists only in Chapter 1. [1]
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations, but the trophy target itself is disputed: 18 versus 15. [1]

Whether the Chapter 1 balcony counts is also disputed: PowerPyx did it and the trophy popped but wrote pending confirmation, OutputLag states it counts, eGamers reports the walkthrough author was not sure, and Push Square lists no missable at all. [5]
Safe play: do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. [1]
Track your count with the counter above — each meditation adds one toward 18. [1]

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his strand. [10]
Bret's hunts unlock through his missions, so follow his strand until a hunt is offered. [6]
Each hunt targets one specific animal — track it, take the shot, and the trophy pops. [1]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. [10]
There are 480 cards in the world, and the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets — any 3 sets earn this trophy. [1]
Use a card-set location guide to plan routes instead of wandering blind. [4]
Finish any three sets; the trophy does not care which ones. [1]

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. [10]
There are 112 WAiNK spots in total, so 12 can be skipped and the trophy still pops. [1]
Follow a WAiNK location list to sweep regions one at a time. [4]
The in-game count tracks your progress — check it before backtracking. [6]

trophies.name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete 50 Challenges of any kind. [10]
The 100% checklist needs more, 70 of 80 challenges, so this trophy is a milestone on the way there. [1]
Challenges span the game's activities, so pick the ones you enjoy and let the count grow. [6]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Build a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you. [10]
Then lose the wanted level and escape the heat together — the trophy needs the escape, not just the stars. [1]
Pick open ground with escape routes nearby instead of a dead end. [6]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner. [10]
Keep your Wanted Level alive through all three robberies — losing it between shops breaks the chain. [1]
Pick three shops close together and plan the route before the first robbery. [6]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles by driving or entering new models. [10]
The 100% checklist needs more, 200 of 277 base models, so keep discovering past this trophy. [1]
New models count on first contact — cruise varied districts instead of one street. [6]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. [10]
Wait until five enemies are grouped together, then trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns. [1]
If the count falls short, the attempt costs nothing — set it up again. [6]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal a parked passenger plane at VCIA and fly it about 1 km to make your unscheduled departure. [1]
Whether the VCIA window is open only during the story is disputed — some guides list this as the second possibly missable, others only as a watch. [1]
Safe play: steal the plane as soon as you can reach VCIA, rather than leaving it for late free roam. [1]
No source confirms the plane can be taken again in free roam, so do not rely on a second chance. [8]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
guide: The description points at Rhino tanks — raise enough heat for Rhinos to respond. [10]
Survive the Rhino encounter once the tanks arrive. [1]
High wanted levels bring the heavy response, so attempt this when you are ready for a fight. [6]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. [10]
Plan the entry first — avoid cameras and guards, and move quietly. [6]
If you are spotted, the attempt fails; back out and try again. [1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one. [10]
There are 8 vaults in the world, so only 5 of them are needed for the trophy. [1]
Each vault is a planned robbery — crack it, take the haul, then escape the response. [4]
Track vaults robbed with the counter so you know how many are left. [1]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an Armored Truck out on the roads in free roam. [10]
Hit the truck, take the cash, then escape the wanted level that follows. [6]
Trucks roam the roads, so patrol busy routes until one appears. [1]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas must be visited. [1]
Areas count when you set foot in them, so sweep the map region by region. [4]
Check the map for unvisited corners before calling the state explored. [6]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. [1]
The 100% checklist needs far more, 39 gang operations in total, so this trophy is only the start. [1]
Operations are marked for free-roam robbery once you find them — hit one per gang. [4]
Use the counter to track which gangs you have already hit. [1]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published for this trophy — PowerPyx lists its trigger as not known. [1]
The description mentions a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; treat that as the only lead, not a verified method. [10]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published for this trophy — PowerPyx lists its trigger as not known. [1]
The description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom; treat that as the only lead, not a verified method. [10]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. [10]
Follow through on the game — finish it rather than walking out mid-frame. [6]
The alley is open in free roam, so this is an easy early trophy. [1]

trophies.name: Personal Best
guide: The description points at the partnership's mass appeal — progress comes through the duo's shared moments. [10]
Play the duo's story and side beats together and the trophy follows the partnership's rise. [6]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile as you play — the trophy tracks what you choose, for better or worse. [4]
The 500-actions figure is single-source: it comes from a GamesRadar+ editorial addition in square brackets and from GTABase, with no second independent source. [9]
Beware the permanent side effect: the Irredeemable profile status cannot be undone, and PowerPyx and GTABase agree on that. [1]
Keep making profile-changing choices across the game; no guide has independently confirmed the exact count. [4]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published for this trophy — PowerPyx lists its trigger as not known. [1]
The description hints at succeeding on a second try; treat that as the only lead, not a verified method. [10]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published for this trophy — PowerPyx lists its trigger as not known. [1]
The description suggests witnessing something strange; treat that as the only lead, not a verified method. [10]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published for this trophy — PowerPyx lists its trigger as not known. [1]
The description points at bowling someone over with a melee drive-by; treat that as the only lead, not a verified method. [10]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. [10]
Marked Bills come from robberies, so keep running them and washing the take. [4]
Use your contacts to launder the bills over time until the total reaches $250,000. [6]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — every shop counts toward the one total. [10]
Buy gear, clothes and vehicles you actually want; the spending adds up on its own. [1]
Big purchases move the total fastest, so save this push for when your wallet is full. [6]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. [1]
Garages are bought with in-game money, so fund them from robberies and jobs. [4]
Buy each garage as you can afford it — the trophy pops on the last one. [6]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

counter.label: Vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app

guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. [10]
Register vehicles you own or find — each new registration adds one to the count. [6]
The app tracks your registrations, so check it before hunting for more vehicles. [1]
